archetypes.name: plan-cli-contracts
archetypes.rationale: Plan-review cutover preserves many byte-stable env and KV contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new plan-review CLI surface against the retired shell contracts. Focus on env files, stdout KVs, result statuses, and wrapper argv compatibility. Flag any contract drift that would break /design Step 3 resumes or Gate B. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: retired-path-sweep
archetypes.rationale: The change deletes many scripts and rewrites references across docs and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit stale references to retired plan-review paths and Makefile or relevant-checks routing. Verify deleted harnesses have replacement pytest routing and that surviving wrappers do not invoke missing scripts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: artifact-security
archetypes.rationale: Design-log artifact allowlists and Step 3 evidence staging moved to Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review artifact allowlist and evidence-staging behavior for symlink, path, and publication-boundary regressions. Check that design-log publishing still rejects unexpected round files and does not broaden committed artifact scope. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
